## ♿ Accessibility & UX Checklist
- [ ] **ARIA Labels:** All icon-only buttons and interactive elements have descriptive `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` attributes.
- [ ] **Semantic HTML:** Used appropriate HTML tags (e.g., `<button>`, `<nav>`, `<h1>`-`<h6>`) to ensure screen reader clarity.
- [ ] **Keyboard Navigation:** Verified that all interactive elements are reachable and usable via the keyboard (Tab, Enter, Space).
- [ ] **Focus States:** All interactive elements have visible focus indicators.
- [ ] **Color Contrast:** Text and interactive elements meet WCAG AA contrast standards.
- [ ] **Bilingual Support:** (If applicable) Bengali content is wrapped in tags with `lang="bn"` for correct screen reader pronunciation.
- [ ] **Alt Text:** All informative images have descriptive `alt` text; decorative images have empty `alt=""`.
